name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: Your founders started Unite Us after seeing how hard it is for people to navigate health and social services. I've lived a version of that: eight years managing a chronic condition, fighting insurers through prior authorizations and appeals to get care approved. I know what it costs when the systems that are supposed to connect don't, and that's why this role stood out to me.

Implementation is the work I know best. At Wix I launched 25+ clients a month with up to 25 in flight, at 110% of my implementation target, while leading onboarding teams of up to 30. At Accelo I built sequenced implementation plans and handed them to the delivery team with clear dependencies. At Birdeye I onboarded 15-20 reseller partners, including agencies serving healthcare clients, and kept all but one by watching adoption data and stepping in early.

Coordinated care networks mean many stakeholders who don't report to anyone in common, and that's where I do my best work: finding out how each one needs to be communicated with and keeping them moving toward the same launch date. I'd welcome a conversation at 303-726-5037 or jrotnbrg@gmail.com.
